_comment: Track 2 Drillbox cards. Wording comes from the supplied drill information: tools/drillbox-w13-pass.json (per-cell objective/success approved for W13) and tools/data/d1-data.json (rev 1280 goal/success/title). Only cells listed here override that data. switch_at is the editorial second where the first clear repetition begins; it is measured from the START OF THE PUBLISHED CLIP, not from the raw take. To show a third RESULT card, add to a cell: "verified": {"successful": 4, "attempts": 6, "at": 16.0} - only supply a count that was actually assessed. No season code, week number, timecode or internal ID is ever rendered.

U11:D1.title: Curved run to press
U11:D1.objective: Close down the receiver with a curved run while protecting the mini-goal.
U11:D1.success: The defender blocks the direct route to the mini-goal as they close down the receiver.
